messages:
noah: heads-up — nightly evals flagged a sharp quality drop for several prompt sets after yesterday's fused-softmax change. outputs look like token collapse / repeated short suffixes. :eyes:
noah: failing evals: eval-suite/curation-v2, conversational-regressions-2026, summarization-smoke. failure rate jumped from ~1.2% -> 14% on q4 quant nightly.
noah: suspected vectorized softmax underflow on fp16 path — traces show lots of -inf in logits for long contexts. attaching quick repro below.
noah: ```bash
# reproduce (remote gpu1)
git checkout 6f2c9b3
python -m eval.run --model rdlw/7b-q4f --prompts eval-suite/curation-v2 --seed 42 --batch-size 1
```
noah: sample bad generation: "The report is complete. The the the the the."
noah: commit that landed: infra/runtime: fused-softmax-microkernel (hash 6f2c9b3) merged 2026-03-04 21:10 UTC.
noah: pinging @maria and @ajay — can we bisect the microkernel change?
maria: ugh, saw a couple of these in quick smoke on staging but assumed transient. reverting the fused path is quick if needed. :grimacing:
maria: ajay — do we still have the old softmax kernel artifact? if so we can toggle via env var and re-run nightly.
ajay: yes, old kernel build is preserved: /opt/kernels/softmax_scalar_v2.so. toggling runtime flag: `RUNTIME_DISABLE_FUSED_SOFTMAX=1`
ajay: logs from failing run (trimmed):
```
[2026-03-05T02:14:12Z] INFO runtime: starting inference batch=7 seq_len=2048
[2026-03-05T02:14:12Z] DEBUG fused_softmax: max_logit = -inf for head=3
[2026-03-05T02:14:12Z] WARN sampler: topk collapse detected, entropy=0.00003
```
```
ajay: also saw this only when quantized kernel + dtype=float16 path used. float32 path seems clean.
sam: question — are we sure it's a numerical underflow vs. RNG/sampling change? some of the output patterns look like sampling RNG seeded differently. what are the nightly seed/temperature settings?
noah: nightly config: seed=12345 (fixed), temperature=0.7, top_p=0.95, decoder sampling. seeds present for reproducibility. RNG code unchanged in that CL.
linda: repro artifact (from failing eval) — prompt + model output (truncated):
"Prompt: Summarize the following legal clause..."
"Model: The clause establishes that the party shall, shall, shall. The party shall. The party shall."
linda: interestingly, some runs show realistic continuation for first 30 tokens then collapse after KV-cache reuse boundary at token ~56.
maria: that KV-cache boundary detail is helpful — might be a prefix normalization mismatch combined with fused softmax's blocking layout.
ajay: quick experiment: re-run with `RUNTIME_DISABLE_FUSED_SOFTMAX=1` and `RUNTIME_FORCE_FP32_SOFTMAX=1` on a failing seed. if that fixes, we pin revert and then run a more careful perf test.
noah: running that now on gpu1 — I'll post results.
noah: result: with both flags set, failure rate drops back to 1.4% and no -inf logits. latency +2% but acceptable.
sam: ok that strongly suggests numeric/fusion bug in the fused path for fp16. can we capture raw logits before softmax on fused path vs scalar path to diff?
ajay: yes, I'll add an opt-in dump hook (small sample) to compare per-head logits and exp-sum. will push a debug build to staging.
maria: long term we should add a unit test for softmax stability on quantized kernels — small softmax with very negative values + large dynamic range. fail fast.
linda: also flagging eval owners: @eng-ml — would be good to run a targeted suite across recent quantized models so we catch this class earlier.
noah: opened infra ticket INF-8243 with logs + failing model list. linking PR to revert candidate: https://git.redwood/infraruntime/pulls/987
infra-bot: Deploybot: revert-pr 987 queued to staging — triggered by noah.
maria: thanks. I can drive the revert if infra-bot gives staging green. after revert we should run the nightly full curation suite asap.
noah: timeline: revert + smoke in staging in ~30m, then nightly will pick up; I'll keep thread updated. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
noah: if anyone has quick ideas for a mitigation patch (e.g., exp clamp, log-sum-exp stable refactor) post the snippet here and I can try in the debug branch.
ajay: will try adding max-clamp before exponential: `x = x - max(x); x = clamp(x, -50, 50)` and retest. report back in ~20m.
noah: great, thanks team.
noah: (later) quick update — clamp hack reduces failures to ~3.2% but still not as good as scalar kernel. keeping revert as primary for now.
maria: agreed. we'll merge revert to main and then open a follow-up to reintroduce fused-softmax behind stricter numeric tests. :white_check_mark:
noah: closing loop: INF-8243 updated with staging logs and perf numbers. will create an eval ticket to add softmax stability checks to pre-merge pipeline.
noah: thanks everyone.
